questions.prompt: A student investigates the reaction of aqueous sodium hydroxide with two different aqueous solutions of hydrochloric acid, solution X and solution Y. She carries out two experiments. Experiment 1 Experiment 2 • She empties the burette and rinses it first with water and then with solution Y. She then fills the burette with solution Y. • She repeats the experiment using solution Y. The table shows the results she obtains in Experiment 1. Experiment 1 – Solution X Volume in cm3 of solution X added Temperature in °C
